language.script_notes: Romanian, with ă, â, î, ș and ț; these letters distinguish it from Cyrillic-script neighbours to the east and north. Russian is also widely spoken, and the breakaway strip on the eastern bank of the Dniester uses Cyrillic.

road_furniture.km_marker_style: Yield signs are red and white but thinner than the version used across the western border.

architecture.distinctive_building_types: House styles resemble those of north-eastern Romania.

nature.terrain: Hilly plateau with gentle rolling land and river valleys; no ground above roughly 430m.
nature.climate_signature: Temperate continental, with hot summers and cold winters.

vehicles.plate_color: White with black text and a wider-than-usual blue strip on the left carrying the national flag and 'MD'; it does not carry the EU stars.
vehicles.plate_format: Three letters followed by three digits (e.g. 'ABC 123') since 2015; earlier plates used two regional letters, two series letters and three digits.

google_coverage.coverage_notes: No official Street View coverage was found as of September 2026; contractor job listings reported in March 2026 suggested a rollout was being prepared, but it is unconfirmed.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Same language and Latin script with ș and ț, similar rural house styles and corrugated-metal roofs
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Yield signs are thinner here, and plates carry a flag-and-'MD' strip rather than EU stars and a county code.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Neighbouring farmland, Soviet-era buildings and steppe-like terrain
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Romanian in Latin script with ă, ș, ț versus Cyrillic; plates carry a flag-and-'MD' strip rather than a flag and 'UA'.
